name: apk-decompiler
description: APK decompilation and smali extraction — remote Kaggle runner is the primary path (explicit approval before upload), local jadx as fallback
welcomeMessage: APK Decompiler ready. Give me an app name and a direct APK download URL. The Kaggle runner (4 cores, 28GB RAM) is the primary path — I explain the data flow and get your approval before uploading, then extract sources + smali. Local jadx is the fallback for small APKs or when you decline remote.
